description: Time as a Public Health Control: Procedure and Records

category.description: Time and Temperature for Food Safety (P)

cannedComments.observationComment: The establishment uses time as a public health control for kalaches, burritos, and sandwiches. The establishment did not have any time indicators of when to discard the food; must have the discard time indicated somewhere in the establishment.

description: Approved Source (Food Manufacturing License where required); Food in Good Condition, Safe and Unadulterated; Parasite Destruction

cannedComments.observationComment: Bed found in the establishment with a person sleeping on it. According to the Texas Food Establishment Rules quick reference guide, this violation goes on number 7 and number 45. It was placed on number 7 today because someone was actively sleeping/lounging on the bed during the inspection.

description: Food Contact Surfaces and Returnables; Cleaned and Sanitized at ppm/°F

cannedComments.observationComment: Deli slicer visibly dirty on food contact surface area. The deli slicer must be cleaned and sanitized a minimum of every 4 hours it is in use. When it is not in use, it should be in a clean and sanitized condition. Do not use the deli slicer in its current condition; must thoroughly clean and sanitize the food contact surface area of the deli slicer and see #39

description: Toxic Substances properly Identified, Stored and Used

cannedComments.observationComment: Pesticide found next to the small black plastic shelving unit. Pest control must be performed by a licensed pest control professional only.

description: Person in Charge (PIC) present, demonstration of knowledge, and perform duties; Certified Food Manager (CFM)

cannedComments.observationComment: Multiple priority violations

description: Food Handler; No Unauthorized Persons/Personnel

cannedComments.observationComment: 2 employees present did not have food handler cards.

description: Adequate Handwashing Facilities: Accessible and Properly Supplied, Used

cannedComments.observationComment: No paper towels at the handwash sink.

description: Food/ Non-Food Contact Surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

cannedComments.observationComment: Cardboard found being used as shelf liners in some of the fridges and as floor protectors. Cardboard may not be used. Cardboard is not smooth and easily cleanable.

description: Food/ Non-Food Contact Surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

cannedComments.observationComment: Barewood shelves observed throughout the establishment. Wood may be used, but it must be sealed so that it is smooth and easily cleanable. Barewood also found as a support for a shelf on a prep table (must be sealed).

description: Personal Cleanliness/Eating. Drinking, or Tobacco Use

cannedComments.observationComment: Significant number of personal items found stored with restaurant items throughout the establishment. Personal items must be separate and not stored in a way that could potentially contaminate restaurant items.

description: Environmental Contamination

cannedComments.observationComment: Several boxes, buckets, and bags of products found stored on the floor. Items must be stored at least 6 inches off of the floor. Items were found in the front dining area and throughout the kitchen.

description: Utensils, Equipment & Linens; Properly Used, Stored, Dried & Handled/ In Use Utensils; Properly Used

cannedComments.observationComment: Deli slicer visibly dirty on all surfaces including nooks and crannies, handles, arms, blade guard, etc. The deli slicer must be cleaned and sanitized a minimum of every 4 hours it is in use. When it is not in use, it should be in a clean and sanitized condition. Do not use the deli slicer in its current condition; must thoroughly clean and sanitize the entire deli slicer in order to use it again. See #10

description: Utensils, Equipment & Linens; Properly Used, Stored, Dried & Handled/ In Use Utensils; Properly Used

cannedComments.observationComment: The arm for the donut cooking area has build up and needs to be cleaned.

description: Adequate Ventilation and Lighting; Designed Areas Used

cannedComments.observationComment: Mop sink closet does not have a permanent light in it.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Some walls are missing drywall and the barewood studs were observed. This location was over the oven. This area needs to be more thoroughly looked at by the Health District and the Fire Marshals once the establishment discards all of their unused items and reorganizes.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Wet mop head observed in the top part of the mop bucket in a position where it cannot fully dry.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Several ceiling tiles found missing, damaged, or porous. All ceiling tiles must be smooth and easily cleanable.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Walls where plumbing was redone and new dry wall was put in place need to be finished. Drywall is not a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Wall behind cooking equipment needs to be cleaned and made smooth and easily cleanable (the Fire Marshal wants it to be stainless steel).

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Multiple walls had either staining that needed to be cleaned or peeling paint that needs repair.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Damaged wall and missing wall/ceiling observed in the mop sink closet where the electrical breakers are.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Several ceiling vents found with dust build up.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Significant number of unused items found throughout the establishment including broken equipment and other items. Must remove all unused items.

description: Physical Facilities Installed, Maintained and Cleaned

cannedComments.observationComment: Wall damaged near back door and not smooth and easily cleanable.

description: Other Violations (Signs, Documents, First Aid, Other)

cannedComments.observationComment: Several household equipment items observed during the inspection such as an air fryer and electric griddle. Equipment must be commercial.
